title: Counting Reachable Positions in a Simplified Model of Connect Four
summary: By eliminating the win condition in the game of Connect Four and extending the board to infinite height, a rich state space of positions is obtained. We investigate the number of positions reachable on an $n$-column board after $k$ color-alternating moves. For fixed $k$ we demonstrate polynomiality, derive a partial formula for the polynomial coefficients, and precisely characterize the asymptotic behavior as $n \to \infty$.
